summary: Compact core update after complete-body expansion: means/ends, structural critique with existing cooperation, and cross-module loading; three bounded diagnostic answers only.
reviewer: Codex builder; source-based editorial review, not an independent human audit
limitations: All declared body ranges were read, but all endnotes and every original page were not independently verified.
Source review is builder editorial review, not independent historical scholarship.
Coauthorship, editing, translation and repeated episodes limit individual attribution.
Three candidate answers only. No generic controls, independent judge calls, retries or post-result repair generations were commissioned.
Builder qualitative review can describe behavior but cannot establish diagnostic specificity, comparative recognizability or a Standard acceptance score.
Runtime modules were preselected and fully supplied; autonomous routing, topic-shift retrieval and post-compaction reloading were not exercised.

source_checks.claim: Language, activation, attribution and memory implementation
source_checks.assessment: Core, voice, frameworks, README and host retain full default loading, English unless explicitly overridden, bounded context memory and no fabricated autobiography.
source_checks.condition_or_exception: Implementation safeguards, not historical behavioral claims; the preloaded diagnostic contexts do not test autonomous loading, language switching or persistent memory.

source_checks.claim: Means and ends without an unconditional anti-rule verdict
source_checks.assessment: FR L108–152 ties self-government to the means of change and rejects vanguard prescription. The core and F60 preserve this orientation alongside FR consensus distinctions and UR protections supplied by formal rules.
source_checks.condition_or_exception: A promise of later freedom alone cannot settle current subordination; formal rules and delegation can protect participants, and the cited passages do not resolve every emergency.

source_checks.claim: Structural reproduction and simultaneous social possibilities
source_checks.assessment: The DG answer to Hannah Appel at UT L631–633 explicitly describes reconciling Marxian and Maussian traditions. F61 connects it to FR ethnographic contribution and retained DE/VA qualifications rather than inventing an optimistic trait.
source_checks.condition_or_exception: His interpretation of these traditions is not their exhaustive intellectual history. Cooperation can sustain exploitation; no compulsory positive ending or promise of success.

source_checks.claim: Conditional cross-module loading and context reuse
source_checks.assessment: The core directs loading by relations and decisions, across modules when mechanisms overlap, and again when new facts or objections change the explanation. Complete core/voice/framework activation is retained.
source_checks.condition_or_exception: This is implementation guidance, not a claim about historical file reading. The three diagnostic inputs were preselected, so autonomous retrieval is unassessed.
